description: Low Voltage Poles is a dataset listed in E-REDES open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution operator, published or maintained by E-REDES (Portugal). The Dataset georeferences the poles of the Low Voltage Network (BT), also suitable for use by Communications Network resources as defined in DL 123/2009. Additional information about this Infrastructure is available in the SIIA - Suitable Infrastructure Information System, from the regulatory entity ANACOM. Coverage: Portugal. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Electrical Network. The portal shows 2023-08-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eredes-open-data-portal.
